'''Ralebedth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] vendor operating out of [[Kaas City]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ralebedth is a Bounty Hunter PvP vendor in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
